step.cmd: From the Type drop-down menu, select Station TLS WebSocket Connection.

stepresult.note: Configure the port to connect to the target station's HTTPS port as defined in the target station's WebService.
stepresult.p: You can still use the Station TLS Connection and the Station Connection option. However, if the initial foxs/fox connection fails, a fall-through connection to foxwss may be attempted as stated in the Connect window: Connect to station using fox over TLS (foxs). May revert to a Station TLS WebSocket Connection on failed foxs attempt.

step.cmd: To configure the fall-through connection attempt to foxwss in , select ToolsOptionsFox Options. Here you can specify the preferred HTTPS port to use for the foxwss fall-through connection attempt.

stepresult.p: You can also adjust the Attempt Fox Over WebSocket If Fox Or Foxs Fails setting to enable or disable the fall-through foxwss connection attempt.
Once a foxwss connection is established from to a station, you can continue to navigate the station as before.
